title: demo.aadhaar_okyc@v1 send_otp response (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: The OTP was sent to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar; the response also carries the X-Hub-Session header for verify_otp. Every failure (invalid Aadhaar, no linked mobile, rate limit) is an error, not a response. Callers must ignore unknown fields.
